notes.title: Spirit Arena 2.3.0 - Release Note
notes.content:
[h1] Brrrr, [i] spirit, are you there[/i]?[/h1]
Oh yes, he's here and so is winter! And as we welcome 2021, [b] Sweet Dreams [/b] is taking advantage of the new year to flood you with new features and a shower of content!

[h1] NEW PRICE! [/h1]
You can't have missed it because it's a worldwide event: [b] Spirit Arena is now available on [u]Switch[/u], [u]PS4[/u] and [u]XBOX ONE[/u] [/b]! A big thanks to our partner [url = https: //www.jandusoft.com/] Jandusoft[/url] for their amazing work on the console port.

On the occasion of this port and to keep in line with console friends, we have decided to lower the price of Spirit Arena to [u][b] 4,99€ ($5,99)[/b][/u].

[h1] PATCH NOTE :[/h1]
[h1]Items [/h1]

[b] [u] [h3] Foreword: [/h3] [/u] [/b]
With this update, we have completely revised the gameplay of items. We wanted to reinforce the [b] strategic [/b] aspect of these, pushing the player to [b] think twice [/b] before taking one item rather than another.
Many new items have been added, but the old ones have also changed dramatically. If you are used to the game, you may be surprised!

[list]
[*] [b] 19 new unique items to discover! [/b]
[*] Unique items [b] no longer respawn [/b] when picked up.
[*] New probabilities of appearance according to their rarity.
[*] It is [b] no longer possible [/b] that [b] 2 objects of the same color [/b] appear at the end of a wave.
[/list]

[h2] Redesign of colored objects [/h2]
[list]
[*] A great effort has been made to harmonize and simplify colored objects.
[*] Removed [b] turquoise [/b] (reduced teleportation delay) and [b] blue [/b] (projectile speed) items.
[/list]

[h2] Overhaul of the rarity mechanic [/h2]
[list]
[*] Items are now sorted into 4 categories, each recognizable by an associated color: [b] common (white), unco (green), rare (blue) and legendary (red) [/b].
[*] From 1 [b] to a dozen [/b], legendary items are now devastating bonuses, but the cost can turn out to be… [b] brutal [/b]!
[/list]


[h1] Gameplay & interface [/h1]
[list]
[*] Now, [b] an interface appears next to the objects [/b] to remind the player of their bonuses and help them make their choice.
[*] Time required to [b] switch from spirit to physical form [/b] (and vice versa) reduced from 2 to 1 second.
[*] [b] Teleport enhancement [/b]: Player is now [b] invincible [/b] for a short period of time after teleporting.
[*] [b] The damage is now divided between each of your projectiles. [/b] Be careful not to divide your forces too much!
[*] [b] All characters have been rebalanced[/b] to stick to the new gameplay.
[/list]

[h1] The beginning of the nightmare [/h1]
[list]
[*]All waves from[b] Nightmare mode [/b]have been reworked and improved.
[*] [b] The infinite mode has been completely revised [/b]: its waves improved, its difficulty is now unique and progressive. Be prepared before you venture into Hell !
[/list]

[h1] Unlocking items and their associated achievements [/h1]
[list]
[*]Achievements have been revised to fit the new gameplay
[*] Items now unlock in a more [b] logical order [/b] and are more [b] rewarding [/b]. The most powerful items are now also the hardest to obtain!
[/list]

notes.title: Summer update
notes.content:
[h1]It's summer time![/h1]

While we are quietly melting in our offices / microwave, we’re still working on Fireflies (follow us!). And we took advantage of the arrival of sunny days to gift you an update of Spirit Arena!

So just to stick to the festive mood, we thought it was time to make some improvements.

[h2]General gameplay:[/h2]
Did you plan to surf this summer? That's good, because we have worked a lot on our waves.

Prepare to deal with hordes of enemies in shorter, more nervous games!
A progressive difficulty for less frustrating parties.
[list]
[*] The HP of all characters has been lowered (except the poor Croo) in order to make the games much more intense. Watch your health bar!
[*] The time to switch from one form to another has been reduced.
[*] All levels are now composed of 9 waves + 1 wave of boss
[*] Monster spawn during boss waves has been drastically reduced for more readable combats
[/list]

[h2]Interface:[/h2]
Access important information at a glance! We have improved the user interface for more enjoyable sessions and better playing comfort.

[list]
[*] Damage, attack speed and range are now visible ingame under the health bar.
[*] The cooldown between two dashes is now clearly displayed on your character's icon.
[*] Each characteristic is now underlined by the color that matches the objects.
[/list]

[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
Still aiming to make the game more nervous, the monsters are now more fragile, but appear in a more sustained way!

[list]
[*] Many monsters have seen their HP reduced
[*] Bosses now have MUCH less HP (sorry, it's our fault the former game designer fell asleep on his numeric keypad)
[*] The “phases” (kinds of waves in the waves) have been deleted and won’t be missed
[/list]

That’s it! We hope you will enjoy these changes. All your feedback is welcome, we are improving thanks to you!

Thank you all for your continuing support, and stay around, something tells me that more improvements could come soon. ;)

Meantime, come say hi on our social networks:
[url=https://discord.gg/cT6MmfB]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/SweetDreamsStd]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Spirit Arena - 2.1.5 Release Note
notes.content:
Merry Christmas !

The holiday season is here, and while some are enjoying a well-deserved vacation, we continue to work hard just for you 😉

The development of Fireflies on a Moonless Night continues quietly, but to celebrate Christmas together, it is an update of Spirit Arena that we offer.

On the menu :
[list]
[*] Christmas content. If you launch Spirit Arena between today and January 3 inclusive, you will unlock Santa Claus and its accessories to help you fight the waves of monsters.
[*] The game is finally available entirely in French. Joyeux Noël les baguettes.
[*] Correction of the backup system. There were times when some successes were unlocked when they shouldn't have been. In addition, the last update made it impossible to unlock new levels. These bugs have been tracked and exterminated.
[*] The statistics for the pause menu are now displayed in green when they cannot be improved, and in red when they cannot be worse.
[*] Corrections of some minor bugs in the menu.
[/list]

We wish you all a great holiday season! See you soon with always more content.

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/MuwuRU6]our official Discord server[/url] to stay informed of the latest news!

notes.title: Spirit Arena - 2.1.4 Release Note
notes.content:
It is with great pleasure that we release this new update for Spirit Arena.
On the menu :
[list]
[*] Some players met an issue with some bosses, that would simply not appear at all. This bug is now history!
[*] Hit and death animations would not play after the first game: the matter is now fixed.
[*] Players could be the same colour if one tried to swap when the other was frozen. This bug in the matrix won’t happen again.
[*] The end of each wave is now smoother. No more picking the wrong item because you were moving at the end of the wave!
[*] The disable time happening when a player take a hit is now shorter. The apple only lengthen the invincibility time following a hit, making it a worthy item eventually!
[/list]
Spirit Arena keep evolving as we begin working on our next project, and it’s thanks to you all!
Have a nice weekend, and see you soon for new updates

notes.title: Spirit Arena - 2.1.2 Release Note
notes.content:
For this weekly update, we wanted to focus on a very important point : the game design!

Many of you asked for it, and we listened! The game is now a bit more coherent and stable. The Easy mode is now really easy, and the hard mode… well, it’s really hard. 

And I think you can understand how difficult is the Nightmare mode.

These changes can be summed up in this quick changelog:

[list]
[*] We improved the global game feeling of the game by changing quite a bit some waves
[*] The Bosses and some monsters now have different behaviours depending of the current difficulty
[*] Boss waves includes more enemies!
[*] Some foes are now more more powerful, in order to create a real challenge
[*] … But the characters are more powerful too! The early game will now be less random.
[/list]

But this is just the first step in our journey to improve the game design of Spirit Arena, and you can be a part of this journey!

If you want to help us, or follow the development of Spirit Arena, you can come to our [url=https://discord.gg/MuwuRU6]official discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Spirit Arena - 2.1.0 Release Note
notes.content:
First major update, only two weeks after the official release of the game! And it adds something that many of you asked for : [b]the Survival game mode[/b]!

In this new game mode, the monsters will not let you any rest! You’ll have to fight, wave after wave, choosing the right items in order to survive… But this time, there will be no other end than death itself!

And because we know that a new game mode isn’t enough, we also created [b]a new arena[/b] only for this mode : [b]The Hell[/b]!

For now, this game mode can still be considered in open beta. We think that there is no technical bug in it, but we’ll try to adapt the difficulty in the future.

But it’s not over ! We also corrected some bugs, and improved some aspects of the game. Here is the complete changelog of this update:

[i][b]Adds[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] New Survival game mode
[*] New arena The Hell
[*] Added heal/damage animations on the characters’ UI
[/list]

[i][b]Changes[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Larger text for item pickup animation
[*] Improved visual effects on Trial Temple
[*] The Mummy got a new heal animation
[/list]

[i][b]Bugfixes[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] When changing the game’s resolution, screens will no longer got an offset
[*] When a character is frozen, the ice animation is played only on it
[*] Items that applies on a random stats or on all stats aren’t broken anymore
[/list]

As always, we want to thank you, because all these improvements can only be made because [b]you help us[/b] ! If you want to follow the game’s development, feel free to join [url=https://discord.gg/MuwuRU6]our official Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Spirit Arena - 2.0.3 Release Note
notes.content:
Like every Friday, it's time for the weekly update ! This week, we tried to make the game a bit more intuitive, and we corrected a lot of bugs too !

Changes :

[list]
[*]Players can now see what type of controller is linked to them (gamepad or keyboard)
[*]Added a tip in the character selection menu if players are not linked to the right controllers
[*]When defeated, the Millenial Tree will kill all the Thorns
[*]In the Grimoire menu and the Character Selection menu, you can now see what achievement you must beat in order to unlock characters & items
[*]In the Achievements menu, you can see what are the conditions to beat the achievements
[*]The “Grab Item” animation is now longer
[/list]

Bugfixes :

[list]
[*]When a physical character die, the “death” animation is now correctly played
[*]When starting a 1 player game just after a 2 player game, the aim cursor of the player 2 is no longer visible
[*]The pause menu don’t show placeholders for characters stats anymore
[*]Players can’t dash when they’re frozen
[*]The death animation for the Trained Mugger is fixed
[*]Replaced some achievements icons
[*]The character selection screen works for 2 players !
[*]The center spawn of Wicked Woods is now visible
[/list]

If you encounter a bug, or if you have a suggestion to make, don’t hesitate to come to our [url=https://discord.gg/cT6MmfB]official Discord[/url] !

notes.title: Spirit Arena - 2.0.2 Release Note
notes.content:

notes.title: Spirit Arena is out Now !
notes.content:
After four months of rough development, we are proud to announce that the little game-jam game made in 48 hours is now better than ever !

[b] Spirit Arena is now out on Steam & Itch.io ! [/b]

Beat waves of enemies alone or with a friend in this colorful twin-stick shooter ! Beat all the achievements, unlock new arenas, new unique characters and new items that can help you in your quest ! Can you defeat all the foes that cross your road ? (Of course you can ! We believe in you !)

If you participate in our open beta, you’re going to see that there is a lot of improvements, such as : new menus, a better game-design, but also more content !

We really want to improve our game, but we need you for that. If you encounter a bug, an error, or if you just want to tell you what you feel, you’re welcome on [url=https://discord.gg/MuwuRU6] our official Discord [/url] !
